title: More than a worn tooth
hook: Two pieces of evidence can answer different questions.

knows: Fossils and models can supply evidence about the past.
doesNotKnow: The worn top can show contact, but the developing tooth beneath it is the clue to replacement in this schematic. Actual fossil interpretation depends on the preserved specimen and its context.

misconception: A worn tooth alone shows whether a replacement was developing.
objective: A schematic jaw shows a worn tooth with a new tooth forming below it. Which observation suggests replacement?
